name: strategy switch on depth exhaustion
mechanism: run a fast strategy while tracking its recursion depth or effort, and when a budget derived from the input size is exceeded switch to a slower strategy with a guaranteed bound

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Introselect' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Selection algorithms:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Introsort': begin with quicksort and switch to heapsort when the recursion depth exceeds a certain level

requires: two strategies for the same task
fails_when: the budget constant is a human prior; too tight wastes the fast path, too loose gives the worst case
